system.name: TokSuite
system.one_liner: Suite of fourteen models differing only in tokenizer plus a multilingual benchmark of real-world perturbations that change tokenization.

content.variant_note: eight tabbed dashed cards (four languages, four perturbations) under one concept box, each with stacked rows of token chips coloured by tokenizer
content.argues: The same concept is cut into very different tokens by different tokenizers, across languages and under real-world perturbations, so tokenizer choice changes model input.
content.subject: The word 'doctor' translated and perturbed in eight dashed cards, each cut into coloured token chips by four tokenizers.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show one concept through many transformations: put the concept word on top and a grid of tabbed dashed cards beneath, each showing the same word translated or perturbed and cut into token chips, with one fixed colour per tokenizer so rows can be compared across cards.
lessons.suits: Tokenization, preprocessing or representation papers where the same input is cut differently by several systems, and robustness benchmarks that show perturbation types.

evidence: The figure illustrates how different tokenizers fragment the concept “doctor” when subjected to OCR errors, orthographic mistakes
Each colored box represents one token across Gemma-2 (yellow), GPT-2 (blue), TokenMonster (green), and XGLM (red) tokenizers.
14 models that share the same initialization, architecture, and data but differ only in their tokenizers.

summary: TokSuite is a set of fourteen models that differ only in their tokenizer, plus a multilingual benchmark of real-world perturbations. Figure 1 shows how four tokenizers cut the concept 'doctor'. A bold grey 'doctor' box and the TokSuite wordmark sit above eight dashed cards with grey tabs: four languages (Turkish, Chinese, Farsi, Italian) and four perturbations (OCR Errors, Orth. Errors, Sim. words, Emojis). Each card stacks rows of rounded token chips, one chip per token, coloured by tokenizer: Gemma-2 yellow, GPT-2 blue, TokenMonster green and XGLM red, with the colour tags set in the gap above the middle cards. Chip widths follow token length, so differences in fragmentation are visible at a glance.
summary_zh: TokSuite 是只在分词器上不同的十四个模型加多语言扰动基准。图 1 以“doctor”为例：八张虚线卡片（四种语言、四类扰动）里，用四色词块展示四种分词器的切分。
notes: All text in the SVG is outlined, so every string was read from the preview and chip splits for Chinese, Farsi and the emoji card may contain transcription slips. Some rows are absent in some cards (no green row in the Chinese and Farsi cards, no red row in the four perturbation cards) and the figure does not say why. The meaning of the '?' chip with 'x 13' is not given. The lavender block colour of the wordmark is read from the picture.
